definition.title: The Low-Tide Crossing
definition.briefing: Neris guides Reef Tender Pell across the low-tide flats. Tideborn cross mud and shallows without the usual slowdown. Clear each patrol and stay near Pell until he reaches the Coral Hold.
definition.successText: Pell reaches the Coral Hold with the tide ledger. Neris can plan an attack on the dry-land customs fort.
definition.failureText: Pell or Neris is lost on the flats. Reset and keep the formation beside the tender.

objectives.text: Escort convoy through all 3 checkpoints. Keep troops within seven tiles so the convoy advances.
Keep Neris Shellsong alive until the convoy arrives.

definition.title: The Customs Causeway
definition.briefing: A prepared cannon covers the dry causeway. Send Shellguards through the southern shallows while the Harpooners hold the crossing. Defeat the cannon and its marked guard with this army.
definition.successText: The causeway opens. Neris chooses to recover the customs records unseen or defend Pell's new tidal basin against the counterattack.
definition.failureText: Neris or both Shellguards fall on the dry road. Reset and approach through the shallows.

objectives.text: Defeat the marked customs cannon and guard. Keep at least one Shellguard alive.
Keep Neris Shellsong alive. The army and zero-resource budget are fixed; reset restores this starting position.

definition.title: Hold the Tidal Basin
definition.briefing: Neris stays to protect Pell's new basin. The attackers arrive along two piers. Hold the Coral Hold for seventy-five seconds. Heal the formation with the Tidecaller's Returning Tide and use the wet ground to meet each wave.
definition.successText: The basin survives and restores water to the harbor wall. Neris follows the returning tide into the Regent's court.
definition.failureText: Neris or the Coral Hold falls before the basin fills. Reset the harbor defense.

objectives.text: Hold the fortress for 75 seconds. The reinforcement allowance is 2; the listed waves are finite.
Keep Neris Shellsong alive during the defense.

definition.title: The Harbor Regent
definition.briefing: The Harbor Regent is forcing the tide into his regulator. Use the Tidecaller's Returning Tide to heal Neris's formation and move clear of pressure circles. Wet routes reach both sides of the court.
definition.successText: The regulator opens and the tide returns to the flats. Neris appoints Pell harbor keeper under a ledger every village can read.
definition.failureText: Neris falls and the regulator remains shut. Reset the court assault.

objectives.text: Defeat Harbor Regent. Survive all three phases and move out of a warning circle or interrupt it with concentrated fire.
Dodge or interrupt at least one telegraphed attack.
